messages:
tess (AE): Quick: GlacierHealth POC tomorrow. Must-haves: SAML SSO, SCIM bulk for ~30k users, RBAC mapping, and domain verification. They also want Dedicated trial pricing and our security questionnaire answers. Mike can you join kickoff?

mike (Solutions Eng): On it. Need IdP metadata and whether Okta will be source-of-truth. For SCIM bulk we support async CSV import + SCIM Bulk endpoint. Chunk size <=2500, default rate 600/min/org.

anya (SE): Pricing: propose 2-GPU Dedicated eval, 14 days, soft cap on tokens. Add one-time import fee for large CSVs (48h lead). I'll draft quote.

rahul (Security): We can share SOC2 Type II and a short Q&A. Note: if they require EU-only hosting, we deploy to eu-west and include DPA excerpt. Also confirm PHI scope.

ops-bot: Event created "GlacierHealth POC Kickoff" 2025-07-10 17:00 UTC. Link: https://cal.example/evt/GLC-POC

mike (Solutions Eng): Quick runbook snippet to share:
```
SAML: provide IdP metadata XML + ACS URL
SCIM Bulk: POST /scim/v2/Bulk (chunk <= 2500), async job >5k
CSV import: upload to staging bucket, allow 48h to schedule
Rate limits: 600/min per org, Retry-After respected on 429
```

tess (AE): Action: @mike produce one-page SAML/SCIM runbook + sample RBAC CSV; @anya finalize quote; @rahul assemble security pack. I'll send presales pack by EOD.
